ann.t: Newspaper Publication of Extract of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026

Picturehouse Media Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the unaudited Financial Results (standalone & consolidated) of the company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
